0.7.1: File › Open lists the graphs on the machine running the server.
`cascade run --node <id>` renders only the outputs you name.
0.7.0: One execution path. `cascade run` no longer falls back to a second, dynamic executor.
A `files` capability for the CLI, so headless runs can read and write project files.
A stage's log output now reaches whoever is running it.
0.5.1: Ready for npm, with the README and this site rewritten for the browser player.
0.5.0: The browser player. `cascade build` exports a graph as a static page with an iframe embed, no Studio server needed.
Each embed runs on its own, so several sketches can share a page.
Particle simulations render the same warm or cold, and nested Feedback loops run in the right order.
0.4.0: A camera node that works like Houdini's, and scenes with lights.
Series: one graph cooked once per parameter set.
Headless WebGPU through Dawn, for renders without a browser.
Studio can call allowlisted shell commands.
0.3.0: Animation: a timeline with a dope sheet, keyframes and expressions on any parameter.
Offline rendering. `cascade run --frames 1-100` writes an image sequence.
A coding agent per sketch, working in the project folder.
